examples.en: "Sorry. I sound like Abby, don't I?"—"No. Not at all."
examples.zh: “抱歉。我听上去像阿比，是吗？”—“不，一点不像。”

examples.en: "Simply avoid her," Abby listened closely as I continued.
examples.zh: “避开她就行了。”我继续说的时候，艾比仔细听着。

examples.en: Abby, you deal with this situation the way you think is right.
examples.zh: 艾比，用你认为正确的方式来处理这件事。
